content_sections.heading: AIIMS Jodhpur Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the AIIMS Jodhpur Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. content_sections.heading: AIIMS Jodhpur Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 3 vacancies are available - 1 for Research Scientist II (Non-Medical), 1 for Research Assistant, and 1 for Data Entry Operator.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Jodhpur Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Research Scientist II (Non-Medical): M. Sc. + Ph. D in relevant subject + 4 years R&D/Teaching experience. Desirable: Experience in Microbiology/Virological techniques. Post-doctoral research/training in relevant subjects. Knowledge of Computer Applications or Bioinformatics and handling Big Data. Research Assistant: Post Graduate degree in Medical Microbiology/ Microbiology, Virology/ Biotechnology/ Life Science. Work experience in clinical virology/microbiology. Data Entry Operator: Graduate, proficient in using MS Office and Data Analysis.

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for AIIMS Jodhpur Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application fee for AIIMS Jodhpur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the AIIMS Jodhpur Recruitment 2026. Candidates can attend the walk-in interview without paying any fee.

faq.answer: The salary offered for the Data Entry Operator post in AIIMS Jodhpur Recruitment 2026 is ₹20,000 per month. This is a contractual position.
